description_en: Creates an origin probing task by calling the CreateApplicationMonitor operation
description_zh: 调用CreateApplicationMonitor接口创建源站探测任务
kebab_example: aliyun ga create-application-monitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --task-name task1 --address https://www.aliyun.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApplicationMonitor

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of a request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance to be probed
parameters.help_zh: 需要探测的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the listener to be probed
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the origin probing task.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
源站探测的任务名称。

名称长度为 1~128 个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The URL or IP address to be probed
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en: The advanced extension options for the listener protocol type of the origin probing task. Different listener protocol types correspond to different extension options
parameters.help_zh: 源站探测任务对应监听协议类型的高级扩展选项。不同源站探测任务的监听协议类型对应不同的扩展选项
parameters.name: options_json

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the automatic diagnostics feature. Valid values:

true

false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动诊断功能。取值：

true：是。

false（默认值）：否
parameters.name: detect_enable

parameters.help_en:
The threshold that triggers automatic diagnostics. Unit: %.

Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 0, which indicates that automatic diagnostics is not triggered
parameters.help_zh:
设置自动诊断触发阈值。单位：%。

取值范围：0~100。

默认值：0，表示不触发自动诊断
parameters.name: detect_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The number of times that the threshold must be reached to trigger automatic diagnostics.

Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
触发自动诊断需要达到触发阈值的次数。

取值范围：1~20。默认值：1
parameters.name: detect_times

parameters.help_en:
The silence period for automatic diagnostics. This parameter specifies the interval between two consecutive automatic diagnostics when the availability does not recover to normal after automatic diagnostics is triggered.

When the availability is consecutively below the automatic diagnostics threshold for the specified number of times (the value of DetectTimes), automatic diagnostics is triggered. If the availability remains below the threshold during the silence period, automatic diagnostics is not triggered again within the silence period. If the availability has not recovered after the silence period, automatic diagnostics is triggered again.

Unit: seconds. Valid values: 300 to 86400. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh:
自动诊断触发沉默时间。表示自动诊断触发后，未恢复到正常，间隔多久触发一次自动诊断。

可用率连续多次（即设置的DetectTimes）低于自动诊断触发阈值时，触发自动诊断，如果可用率在自动诊断触发沉默时间内持续低于自动诊断触发阈值，在自动诊断触发沉默时间内不会重复出发自动诊断；如果可用率在自动诊断触发沉默时间后仍未恢复正常，则再次触发自动诊断。

单位：秒。取值范围：300~86400。默认值：300
parameters.name: silence_time

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the origin probing task
